shortDescription: Module for setup of BotDetectionPolicy Avi RESTful Object

options.name: allow_list
options.description: Allow the user to skip botmanagement for selected requests. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: client_behavior_detector
options.description: The client behavior configuration used in this policy. Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: configpb_attributes
options.description: Protobuf versioning for config pbs. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: description
options.description: Human-readable description of this bot detection policy. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: ip_location_detector
options.description: The ip location configuration used in this policy. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: ip_reputation_detector
options.description: The ip reputation configuration used in this policy. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of this bot detection policy. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: system_bot_mapping_ref
options.description: System-defined rules for classification. It is a reference to an object of type botmapping. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: system_consolidator_ref
options.description: The installation provides an updated ruleset for consolidating the results of different decider phases. It is a reference to an object of type botconfigconsolidator. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: The unique identifier of the tenant to which this policy belongs. It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: user_agent_detector
options.description: The user-agent configuration used in this policy. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: user_bot_mapping_ref
options.description: User-defined rules for classification. These are applied before the system classification rules. If a rule matches, processing terminates and the system-defined rules will not run. It is a reference to an object of type botmapping. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: user_consolidator_ref
options.description: The user-provided ruleset for consolidating the results of different decider phases. This runs before the system consolidator. If it successfully sets a consolidation, the system consolidator will not change it. It is a reference to an object of type botconfigconsolidator. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: A unique identifier to this bot detection policy. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.
